instruction: A hammerhead shark sculpted as a single pour of mirror-polished liquid metal, its wide mallet-shaped head smeared into a perfect reflective bar with eyes as smooth dimples. The body tapers through molten ripples that flow along the flanks into a crescent tail, and the dorsal fin rises like a blade of quicksilver. The entire surface warps its surroundings into stretched bands of silver, white, and shadow.
